notes: The table documents the states H2 must reach; keep the ceiling rules

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > a harness implements cancelTurn exactly when the matrix says it can be asked
invariant: each harness exposes cancelTurn iff its row is not unsupported
notes: Cancel availability in the capability surface

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > Codex is the only harness whose real cancel path can reach verified_clear
invariant: a real Codex cancel over the fake app-server reports verified_clear via backgroundTerminals/list, and no other row claims it
notes: verified_clear only with a real inventory

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > ACP's real cancel path never reports cleanup above its row
invariant: ACP cancel outcomes stay at or below unknown across alive, dead, and hung processes

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > a provider that never answers the interrupt is bounded, and is never reported terminal
invariant: an unanswered cancel resolves at the deadline as running+cancellation_timeout
replacement: KEEP(timing: bounded wait on a hung provider)

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > a cancel that rejects while the stream is still open reports the provider's error, not a stopped turn
invariant: a rejecting cancel reports running+provider_unreachable with the provider's message
replacement: KEEP(fault injection: refused cancel while turn runs)

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > a producer that left after a cancel the provider refused is unknown, never terminal
invariant: a clean-looking producer exit over a refused cancel reports unknown, not terminal
replacement: KEEP(fault injection: exit over unacked cancel)

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > a turn whose owner retired live resources reports them as owned
invariant: a retired-with-ownership turn reports cleanup owned and execution unknown

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > a harness with no local turn refuses to claim anything about it
invariant: cancelling a session with no live turn returns unknown/unknown

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > stopping one session's turn leaves another session's turn running
invariant: cancelling session a leaves session b's turn admitted and unaborted

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > an ACP agent that acknowledges the cancel is terminal only over a local transport
invariant: a stdio ACP cancel ack reports terminal; a websocket one reports unknown+provider_unreachable
notes: Remote cancel is never proven (see H24's remote rules)

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > an ACP prompt that never settles after the acknowledgement is bounded
invariant: a hung post-ack wait resolves running+cancellation_timeout

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > an ACP session whose process is gone reports that, never a stopped turn
invariant: a dead process's cancel reports unknown+provider_unreachable and marks the session interrupted
notes: Also covers the H9 dead-process path

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > a transient cancellation failure does not poison the retry
invariant: a failed stop retries, a later success clears the recorded failure, and a succeeded stop is not replayed

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > a concurrent second stop joins the attempt in flight rather than starting another
invariant: concurrent stop calls share one attempt

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > a late answer from an old turn is refused and reported to the session's owner
invariant: a reply to a superseded generation throws, never resolves the provider, and reports the failure to the owner
notes: H3 covers refused stale replies; the owner-failure report is the extra seam

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > an interaction the store could not project reaches the session's owner, not only its caller
invariant: a reply whose appendEvent throws surfaces the failure in the owner's failure sink

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > a failure an adapter reports about a session reaches that session's recovery inspection
invariant: reportOwnerFailure lands in runtime.recovery.inspect().failures for that session only
notes: Inspect output shape: failures on the session target

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > the loser of a deadline race releases its timer and its listener
invariant: the losing side of abort-vs-deadline clears its timer and removes its abort listener
replacement: KEEP(timing: race cleanup, no leaked timer/listener)

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > every harness factory hands its adapter the runtime's failure sink
invariant: each factory's created adapter receives the runtime's reportOwnerFailure
replacement: OBSOLETE(the per-factory composition layer; the registry composes transports in the rebuild)
notes: The invariant (failures reach the owner) is re-established at the broker/transport boundary

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > Pi's real cancel path never reports cleanup above its row
invariant: a real Pi cancel stays below verified_clear since Pi enumerates nothing

test (describe > name): per-harness recovery capability matrix > Cursor and Claude own no inventory, so their real cancel paths stay below verified_clear
invariant: cursor and claude cancels report terminal but never verified_clear

test (describe > name): a prompt sent while a real harness runs a turn > claude takes it into the running turn, which then ends without an abort
invariant: a steered prompt joins the running turn's assistant message, a stale cancel is refused generation_conflict, and the turn idles
notes: Generated live case: claude; opt-in via CLAXEDO_LIVE_HARNESS. Also asserts stale-cancel refusal

test (describe > name): a prompt sent while a real harness runs a turn > codex takes it into the running turn, which then ends without an abort
invariant: same for codex (turn/steer)

test (describe > name): a prompt sent while a real harness runs a turn > pi takes it into the running turn, which then ends without an abort
invariant: same for pi (rpc steer)

test (describe > name): a prompt sent while a real harness runs a turn > cursor cannot take one, so the runtime queues it behind the running turn
invariant: a steer request on Cursor queues, a stale cancel is refused, and the queued prompt runs after the first idles
notes: Generated live case: cursor; queue fallback is H7's "unknown" path
